note: Bands on the 1-6 scale (no neutral midpoint, forced-choice). Boundaries are proportionally rescaled from the original 1-7 ECR-R convention.

bands.label: Secure in the bond
bands.description: Generally trusts a partner's care without needing frequent reassurance; doesn't dwell on fears of abandonment.

bands.label: Occasionally reassurance-seeking
bands.description: Mostly settled, but can spiral into worry about a partner's feelings under stress or ambiguity.

bands.label: High need for reassurance
bands.description: Frequently worries about a partner's love or commitment; closeness can come with real anxiety about losing it.

bands.label: Comfortable with closeness
bands.description: At ease sharing feelings and depending on a partner; doesn't need much distance to feel safe.

bands.label: Selective about closeness
bands.description: Opens up with the right person and pace, but has real limits on how much dependence feels comfortable.

bands.label: Prefers independence
bands.description: Closeness and dependence feel uncomfortable; tends to self-rely and keep some emotional distance even in committed relationships.

combined_patterns.label: Secure
combined_patterns.description: Comfortable with both closeness and independence; trusts relationships without excessive worry or need for distance.

combined_patterns.label: Anxious-preoccupied
combined_patterns.description: Deeply values closeness but often worries about whether it's reciprocated or at risk.

combined_patterns.label: Dismissive-avoidant
combined_patterns.description: Values independence and self-sufficiency; closeness isn't feared exactly, just not prioritized or needed.

combined_patterns.label: Fearful-avoidant
combined_patterns.description: Wants closeness but distrusts it — pulled between wanting connection and protecting against getting hurt by it.
